title: Cut G20 port route words by 73% with exact sparse bases
body:
The 111 actual G20 ports do not need the fixed dense bases in PR5801. This package constructs exact sparse bases for the same line/complement projectors and binds them to all 7,548 source route markers. ADDs fall 202,640 → 53,448; scales fall 73,916 → 21,012. Every coefficient count decreases, so the saving holds for every positive assignment of the same named tariffs.

The initial Walsh design was reduced to three pair rotations. A second determinant-one shear construction removes all scales; its exact tariff condition is stated and checked. Both complete forward/inverse catalogues are emitted.

Verification covers all source ports, all complement columns, both inverse products, independent dense products, literal reflected paired address actions, and the exact source event/owner/phase join. Registered normal and optimized replay, an empty-PATH read-only Git-free export, committed-byte and export checks pass. Three semantic controls reject a wrong basis with a coherent inverse, a forbidden scale, and a wrong route owner.

This improves the conditional finite route cost. It does not implement physical ROW tape/cache/carry/type/padding/borrow contracts, change the paid profile, establish a new kappa, or change the selected frontier. No global rational-word minimum is claimed. Hosted scientific replay and independent acceptance remain pending.

Source and contract credit: PR5798, ToikY PR5801/5805, Dugongue, ai-nanachi, and all retained native/ROW authors in NOTICE. Source bytes and exact pins are retained. New construction and checks by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents.

Canonical claim and handoff: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5804

Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/g20-sparse-port-construction`.

Base: `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`. Verified head: `04b5db84b4b02bdc17e1c6287dfcf8b9c04199d4`.

Prepared for Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Retained tool and mathematical predecessor credits apply. No selected-frontier change.

Hosted status at this exact head: the [planning job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40440546792/job/121979593225) fails in the unchanged `test_research_current_assignment.py` suite (eight failures and two errors); scientific replay is **skipped**. Exact logs were checked. Existing [PR5761](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5761) contains the shared test repair. The complete local and sealed-export checks above are the scientific evidence supplied here; hosted scientific success is not claimed.
